Author: Relicable contributors
Name: Relicable
Changelog:
1.5.4.5 - everything since 1.5.3.2:

Combat: engage range is measured to the target's hitbox edge everywhere, so it no longer stands just out of reach re-approaching forever; ranged jobs and casters hold at about 15 yalms instead of walking into melee; it fights back when attacked while waiting, walking, or staging, chases adds that pull from range, and no longer hard-targets a friendly healer as an 'aggressor'.

Relic: taking the relic off is now a weapon swap (a main hand can never be empty), so upgrades and hand-ins no longer silently stall; a Paladin's Holy Shield is put back in the right hand; the gear set you are wearing follows the relic through each upgrade.

Books and FATEs: a FATE already up in your zone runs first instead of being flown away from; an unreachable FATE target is skipped instead of hanging the run; pick which kinds of book work run (Enemies, Leves, Dungeons, FATEs) or jump a specific entry with Run next.

Also: Aetheryte Tickets can pay for expensive teleports (threshold in /relic config), the Braves shopping list can pull materials from your retainers, and A Treasured Mother reports to Ealdwine at Swiftperch, not Brangwine.
Punchline: Automate the ARR Zodiac relic line (Early Alpha, access code required)
Description:
EARLY ALPHA - an access code from the developer is required to run this plugin; it will not start without one.

Data-driven automation engine for the ARR Zodiac relic line (A Relic Reborn through Zodiac Zeta). It plans and drives the stage objectives - Atma FATE farming, Animus book leves and dungeons, Novus materia/scroll planning, Nexus light farming, and the Jalzahn/Gerolt upgrade turn-ins - by orchestrating other plugins over IPC rather than replacing them.

Requires these companion plugins, installed and working: vnavmesh (movement), BossMod Reborn, Rotation Solver Reborn or Wrath Combo (combat), Lifestream (aetheryte travel), TextAdvance (dialogue), and AutoDuty (dungeons). The Dependencies tab in /relic config shows live status for each.

USE AT YOUR OWN RISK: automating movement and combat is botting under the FINAL FANTASY XIV User Agreement, and Square Enix suspends and terminates accounts for it. The risk is highest for the open-world stages (Atma, Animus, Nexus, Zeta), which run in shared content where other players can observe and report you. Neither this plugin nor its authors can reduce that risk or protect you from it.

This is alpha software that takes control of your character for long unattended sessions. It is incomplete, it has rough edges, and stages will occasionally stall and need manual help. Do not run it unattended if that is not acceptable to you. Bug reports should include /xllog output with 'Enable debug log' turned on in /relic config.
FeedbackMessage: Please report issues on GitHub: https://github.com/OmegaJackie/Relicable/issues - never paste your Early Alpha access code into a report.
